name: Potty Rockets [🪐Saturn Update]
desc:
Welcome to Potty Rockets, the ultimate mix of chaos, comedy, and cosmic adventure! Stuff your face with outrageous food, fuel your toilet-powered rocket, and blast yourself through space like an absolute legend. 

🎁 Join our community & rate the game to unlock an exclusive pet reward! 🦄

✨ Why You’ll Love It: ✨
😋 Eat & Grow Wildly – Every bite powers your rocket to new heights!
🚀 Epic Toilet Launches – Feel the thrill as you break the atmosphere in style.
🛠️ Upgrade Everything – From boosters to bling, build your dream potty rocket.
🐾 Collect & Flex Pets – Cute, cool, and cosmic—your space buddies await.
🤝 Play with Friends – Share food, race to space, and show off your upgrades!
🪐 Explore Crazy Worlds – Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, and more coming soon!
